authority: CEO R334 — thin CRM-compatible commercialization layer. Technology engine sovereign.

architecture.principle: Technology Fabric owns truth. CRM owns relationships. Two systems, one interface.

crm_layer.records: buyer → technology → interaction → interest → objection → diligence → experiment → commercial_outcome
crm_layer.cannot_do: promote/demote technical readiness based on buyer enthusiasm/rejection

bridge.buyer_feedback: creates COMMERCIAL knowledge atoms (distinct from scientific knowledge atoms)
bridge.ai_use: aggregated buyer feedback can prioritize redesign, experiment selection, candidate search, packaging — but cannot alter technical state
bridge.ceo_role: CEO remains human buyer interface. Machine does not contact buyers.

commercial_knowledge_atoms.definition: Aggregated buyer feedback that informs commercialization strategy. Distinct from scientific knowledge atoms. Cannot alter technical evidence or state.

schema.frequency: N out of M buyers mentioned this
schema.commercial_action: e.g., redesign packaging to reduce integration burden
schema.scientific_action: NONE — commercial KA cannot change technical state

buyer_opportunity_schema.stage: PACKAGE_SENT / EVALUATING / NDA / DILIGENCE / EXPERIMENT_COMMISSIONED / NEGOTIATION / DEAL / DECLINED
buyer_opportunity_schema.next_action: follow-up call / send protocol / await experiment / etc.
buyer_opportunity_schema.commercial_outcome: PENDING / LICENSED / ACQUIRED / COMMISSIONED / REJECTED / EXPIRED

buyer_specific_packaging.principle: Core technology package remains invariant. Presentation adapts to buyer type.
buyer_specific_packaging.implementation: Package generator selects fields to emphasize based on buyer_type. All fields remain present (no hiding evidence). Only emphasis changes.

separation_enforcement.rule_1: CRM data cannot write to technology_fabric evidence ledger
separation_enforcement.rule_2: Buyer interest level cannot change T-level
separation_enforcement.rule_3: Buyer rejection cannot change candidate state to CEMETERY
separation_enforcement.rule_4: Commercial KA cannot create scientific KA
separation_enforcement.rule_5: Deal status (NEGOTIATION) does NOT mean T5 (transfer-ready)
separation_enforcement.rule_6: All commercial numbers classified: OBSERVED / SOURCE_DERIVED / MODELLED / ESTIMATED / ASSUMED

commercialization_funnel.target: 15 technologies → 150 potential companies → 50 targeted → 25 responses → 12 serious → 7 experiments → 3 negotiations → 1 license/acquisition
commercialization_funnel.current_state: 0 companies contacted (CEO-owned). Machine ready to track when CEO begins outreach.

what_TO_build: Buyer interaction record (who, when, what they said)
Objection aggregation (N out of M buyers mentioned X)
Commercial KA creation from aggregated objections
Buyer-specific package emphasis (same truth, different lens)
Commercialization funnel tracking (how many at each stage)
Duplicate outreach prevention (Company X already contacted for P-16)
